info.title: API.SH: Clutch
info.description: The Clutch API from API.SH: public Clutch data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Service providers listed on a Clutch directory page for a service and location: id, name, position, listing type (sponsored or organic), profile link, website, logo, rating, review count, verification level, minimum project size, average hourly rate, employees, location, tagline and description. Narrow by `hourly_rate` band, `min_rating` or `min_reviews`, or sort by rating. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/clutch-directory

parameters.name: hourly_rate
parameters.description: Average hourly rate band in US$, as the site lists them: `25-49`, `50-99`, `100-149`, `150-199`.

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Keep only providers rated at least this (0-5, e.g. `4.8`). Clutch has no rating filter of its own, so this narrows the providers of the requested page (`page_providers` is the page's size before it); combine with `sort=rating` to get the best-rated first.

parameters.name: min_reviews
parameters.description: Keep only providers with at least this many reviews on the requested page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Clutch's site search for a keyword: matching provider profiles (name, slug for /clutch/v1/company, link, rating, review count, logo), the directory lists that match (e.g. top React developers in a city) and resources. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/clutch-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words, e.g. a company name or a skill.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
